load_awq_quantized_model: load an AWQ-quantized Llama 3.1 405B model with 4-bit quantization and auto device mapping
configure_awq_quantization: configure AWQ quantization with 4-bit precision and fused attention for reduced memory usage
apply_chat_template: apply a chat template to a list of message dicts and return tokenized input tensors for generation
generate_text_response: generate a text response from the quantized LLM model with sampling and a max token limit
decode_model_outputs: decode model generation outputs into human-readable strings skipping special tokens
